development_validation.allowed_use: debugging, candidate comparison, and regression checks

historical_walkforward_development.purpose: stress-test sign, breadth, and regime stability without waiting for the live market
historical_walkforward_development.universe: all locally built price tickers including retained delisted names; eligibility is determined from point-in-time price and dollar-volume data inside each fold
historical_walkforward_development.excluded_feature_reason: FMP rows are publication-timestamped but the archive is not proven statement-vintage/restatement-safe; rebuild from original filing accessions before historical edge claims
known_limitations: The current feature and mechanism families were designed after observing portions of these years, so the folds are not untouched discovery evidence.
The locally assembled all-cap universe includes delisted names but is not a complete frozen census of every historically listed US equity.
Historical provider corrections and corporate-action restatements can differ from the values available in real time.

fixed_controls.train_label_purge: training exits on or after test_start are excluded
fixed_controls.test_label_mask: test exits on or after exclusive test_end are excluded
fixed_controls.market_adjustment: a candidate must survive both raw SPY-relative and trailing 252-session beta-adjusted SPY-relative net returns; beta requires 126 prior observations and is clipped to [0,3]
fixed_controls.inference: equal-weight entry-date clusters with horizon-aware Newey-West HAC; the per-cell p-value is the conservative maximum of raw-SPY and beta-adjusted tests
fixed_controls.within_fold_multiplicity: BH FDR and Bonferroni over every eligible mechanism-horizon cell

aggregate_gate.combined_p_method: one-sided Stouffer over non-overlapping eligible folds
aggregate_gate.combined_multiplicity: Bonferroni over every aggregate mechanism-horizon cell
aggregate_gate.result_class: stable historical development candidate, never production-validated edge

rules: Freeze the evaluated mechanism set and thresholds before the first session; 2026-08-03 was excluded because the beta-robust architecture and candidate set were not locked before its open.
Do not tune from outcomes inside the window.
Score every eligible signal, including no-trades and blocked trades.
Report date-clustered cost-net alpha, calibration, drawdown, and turnover.
Do not claim production edge before the minimum window completes.
